items.headline: Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan sign treaty creating a Supreme Council of Strategic Partnership
items.summary: Presidents Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Serdar Berdimuhamedov signed a treaty on 8 October establishing a Supreme Council of Strategic Partnership, on the sidelines of the Central Asia and Azerbaijan consultative meeting in Avaza. The Uzbek presidential press service said the council is meant to institutionalise political dialogue and practical cooperation. Both sides called for an action plan to expand bilateral trade.
items.note: Both reports rely on the Uzbek presidential press service. No trade figures were published.
